scanNote:
WORKBOOK 11-UNITNING IKKINChI BETI (47-bet). Yuqorida o'ngda 'Our Precious Planet' va to'q sariq '11'.

⚠⚠ MUHIM: KITOBNING 46-BETI (11-unitning BIRINChI beti - Vocabulary 1-4-mashqlar) SKANDA YO'Q! PDF 46 = kitob 47-bet (16-betdan keyin ikkinchi yo'qolgan bet; bundan keyin PDF N = kitob N+1). Egasiga xabar berish kerak.

CHAP USTUN:
5) 'Fill in the opposites of the adjectives in bold.' Qiya: 'new, rare, heavy, clean'. 1 A: Is this lake ......? B: No, it's very dirty. 2 A: Are these plants very ......? B: No, they're common. You can find them everywhere. 3 A: You've got an old car, haven't you? B: No, I've got a ...... one. 4 A: The traffic must be very light at seven o'clock in the morning. B: Normally it is, but today it was very ...... . There was a serious accident in the city centre.
• 'Grammar':
6) 'Match the problems to the advice.' 1 I want to lose weight. 2 I want to go to university. 3 I can't sleep at night. 4 I've got a really bad cold. 5 I'd like to go on holiday this summer. 6 Someone has stolen my purse. | a If I were you, I'd see a doctor. b If I were you, I'd call the police. c If I were you, I'd go on a diet. d If I were you, I'd study harder. e If I were you, I'd drink less coffee. f If I were you, I'd start saving some money.
7) 'What would Bill do if he won a million pounds? Make sentences, as in the example.' 4 SURAT: A sport mashina - buy/new car; B basseynli uy - move into/house/pool; C kruiz kemasi - go/on/cruise; D vertolyot - buy/helicopter. Qiya namuna: 'If Bill won a million pounds, he would buy a new car.'

O'NG USTUN:
8) 'Make sentences using conditionals type 2, as in the example.' 1 I'm not rich. I can't give much money to charity. ...If I were richer, I'd give more money to charity.... 2 People waste water. There are serious water shortages in many parts of the world. 3 I have got a car. I don't cycle to work. 4 Factories pour chemicals into rivers. Rivers are polluted. 5 People leave rubbish on beaches. They are dirty. 6 We don't take care of our planet. It's in danger. 7 He hasn't got a garden. He doesn't grow vegetables. 8 Mary lives in a flat. She hasn't got a dog.
9) 'Finish the sentences about yourself, using conditionals type 2.' 1 If I had a bicycle, ...... 2 If I had enough money, ...... 3 If I were you, ...... 4 If I worked fewer hours, ...... 5 If I had a big house, ......
10) 'Fill in the correct tense and identify the type of conditionals used (0, 1 or 2).' 1 If people ...used... (use) bicycles to get around, they would be fitter. ...type 2... 2 If animals ...... (not/keep) in cages, they feel happier. ...... 3 If you ...... (take) more exercise, you'll be fitter. ...... 4 If I ...... (have) a car, I would use it to get to work. ...... 5 If you ...... (heat) water to 100°C, it boils. ...... 6 If you ...... (wear) suncream, you won't burn. ......

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '47'.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the opposites of the adjectives in bold: new, rare, heavy, clean.
exercises.instructionUz: Qalin harfli sifatlarning antonimlarini qo'ying: new, rare, heavy, clean.
exercises.explanationUz:
⚠ 46-BET SKANDA YO'Q - 1-4-mashqlar
  yo'qolgan. Bu bet 5-mashqdan
  boshlanadi.

ANTONIMLAR (coursebook 77-bet
  7-mashq):

  dirty ↔ CLEAN
  common ↔ RARE (noyob)
  old ↔ NEW
  light (traffic) ↔ HEAVY (traffic)


⚠ 'HEAVY TRAFFIC':

  = tirbandlik (og'ir emas!).
  'light traffic' = kam mashina.


⚠ 'COMMON' vs 'RARE':

  common = keng tarqalgan, oddiy
  rare = noyob, kam uchraydigan.


⚠ 'HAVEN'T YOU?':

  = shundaymi? (question tag).

exercises.explanationUz:
'IF I WERE YOU, I'D ...' - MASLAHAT
  (2-tur shart gap, coursebook
  78-bet).

  If I were you, I'd (= I would) +
  fe'l = Sizning o'rningizda bo'lsam,
  ... qilardim.

  ⚠ 'If I WERE you' ('was' EMAS -
  2-tur shartda 'were').

  1 ozmoqchi → diet (c)
  2 universitet → study harder (d)
  3 uxlolmayapti → less coffee (e)
  4 shamollagan → doctor (a)
  5 ta'til → save money (f)
  6 hamyon o'g'irlangan → police (b)


⚠ 'TO GO ON A DIET':

  = parhez qilmoq.


⚠ 'TO SAVE MONEY':

  = pul jamg'armoq.

exercises.instructionEn: What would Bill do if he won a million pounds? Make sentences, as in the example. A buy/new car B move into/house/pool C go/on/cruise D buy/helicopter. Example: If Bill won a million pounds, he would buy a new car.
exercises.instructionUz: Bill million funt yutib olsa nima qilardi? Gaplar tuzing, namunadagidek. A buy/new car B move into/house/pool C go/on/cruise D buy/helicopter. Namuna: Agar Bill million funt yutib olsa, yangi mashina sotib olardi.
exercises.explanationUz:
2-TUR ShART GAP (Conditional Type
  2) - XAYOLIY VAZIYAT.

  IF + PAST SIMPLE, ... WOULD + fe'l
  'If Bill WON ..., he WOULD buy'

  ⚠ Hozir/kelajakdagi XAYOLIY,
  ehtimoli kam holat (million
  yutish).
  ⚠ 'won' - past simple, lekin
  ma'no O'TGAN ZAMON EMAS!


⚠ 'TO MOVE INTO':

  = ... ga ko'chib o'tmoq.


⚠ 'TO GO ON A CRUISE':

  = kruizga (dengiz sayohatiga)
  bormoq.

exercises.instructionEn: Make sentences using conditionals type 2, as in the example. 1 I'm not rich. I can't give much money to charity. 2 People waste water. There are serious water shortages in many parts of the world. 3 I have got a car. I don't cycle to work. 4 Factories pour chemicals into rivers. Rivers are polluted. 5 People leave rubbish on beaches. They are dirty. 6 We don't take care of our planet. It's in danger. 7 He hasn't got a garden. He doesn't grow vegetables. 8 Mary lives in a flat. She hasn't got a dog. Example: If I were richer, I'd give more money to charity.
exercises.instructionUz: 2-tur shart gap bilan gaplar tuzing, namunadagidek. 1 I'm not rich. I can't give much money to charity. 2 People waste water. There are serious water shortages in many parts of the world. 3 I have got a car. I don't cycle to work. 4 Factories pour chemicals into rivers. Rivers are polluted. 5 People leave rubbish on beaches. They are dirty. 6 We don't take care of our planet. It's in danger. 7 He hasn't got a garden. He doesn't grow vegetables. 8 Mary lives in a flat. She hasn't got a dog. Namuna: Agar boyroq bo'lsam, xayriyaga ko'proq pul berardim.
exercises.explanationUz:
2-TUR ShART - HAQIQATNING
  TESKARISI.

  ⚠ Haqiqat TASDIQ bo'lsa → shart
  INKOR (va aksincha):
  'People WASTE water' → 'If people
   DIDN'T waste water'
  'I HAVE a car' → 'If I DIDN'T
   have a car'
  'He HASN'T got a garden' → 'If he
   HAD a garden'

  ⚠ Natija ham teskari:
  'There ARE shortages' → 'there
   WOULDN'T be shortages'


⚠ 'WATER SHORTAGES':

  = suv tanqisligi.


⚠ 'TO POUR CHEMICALS':

  = kimyoviy moddalarni to'kmoq.


⚠ 'RUBBISH':

  Brit. = axlat (AQSh 'garbage').


⚠ 'TO TAKE CARE OF':

  = g'amxo'rlik qilmoq.
exercises.exampleEn: If I were richer, I'd give more money to charity.
exercises.exampleUz: Agar boyroq bo'lsam, xayriyaga ko'proq pul berardim.
modelAnswers: If people didn't waste water, there wouldn't be serious water shortages in many parts of the world.
If I didn't have a car, I would cycle to work.
If factories didn't pour chemicals into rivers, rivers wouldn't be polluted.
If people didn't leave rubbish on beaches, they wouldn't be dirty.
If we took care of our planet, it wouldn't be in danger.
If he had a garden, he would grow vegetables.
If Mary didn't live in a flat, she would have a dog.
modelAnswersUz: Agar odamlar suvni isrof qilmasa, dunyoning ko'p joylarida jiddiy suv tanqisligi bo'lmasdi.
Agar mashinam bo'lmasa, ishga velosipedda borardim.
Agar fabrikalar daryolarga kimyoviy moddalar to'kmasa, daryolar ifloslanmasdi.
Agar odamlar plyajlarda axlat qoldirmasa, ular iflos bo'lmasdi.
Agar sayyoramizga g'amxo'rlik qilsak, u xavf ostida bo'lmasdi.
Agar uning bog'i bo'lsa, sabzavot yetishtirardi.
Agar Meri kvartirada yashamasa, iti bo'lardi.

exercises.instructionEn: Finish the sentences about yourself, using conditionals type 2. 1 If I had a bicycle, ... 2 If I had enough money, ... 3 If I were you, ... 4 If I worked fewer hours, ... 5 If I had a big house, ...
exercises.instructionUz: O'zingiz haqingizda gaplarni 2-tur shart gap bilan tugating. 1 If I had a bicycle, ... 2 If I had enough money, ... 3 If I were you, ... 4 If I worked fewer hours, ... 5 If I had a big house, ...
exercises.explanationUz:
2-TUR ShART - O'Z JAVOBINGIZ.

  Natija qismi: I WOULD ('d) +
  fe'l.

  ⚠ 'If I were you' - maslahat
  (6-mashq kabi).

If I were you, I would study English every day.

modelAnswersUz: Agar velosipedim bo'lsa, har kuni maktabga velosipedda borardim.
Agar yetarli pulim bo'lsa, dunyo bo'ylab sayohat qilardim.
Sizning o'rningizda bo'lsam, har kuni ingliz tilini o'rganardim.
Agar kamroq soat ishlasam, oilam bilan ko'proq vaqt o'tkazardim.
Agar katta uyim bo'lsa, ko'p bazmlar o'tkazardim.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the correct tense and identify the type of conditionals used (0, 1 or 2). Example: If people used (use) bicycles to get around, they would be fitter. - type 2
exercises.instructionUz: To'g'ri zamonni qo'ying va shart gap turini aniqlang (0, 1 yoki 2). Namuna: If people used (use) bicycles to get around, they would be fitter. - type 2
exercises.explanationUz:
UCh TUR ShART GAP:

  TYPE 0 - umumiy haqiqat:
    If + PRESENT, PRESENT
    'If you heat water, it boils.'
  TYPE 1 - real kelajak:
    If + PRESENT, WILL
    'If you take exercise, you'll
     be fitter.'
  TYPE 2 - xayoliy:
    If + PAST, WOULD
    'If I had a car, I would use
     it.'

  ⚠ KALIT - natija qismiga qarang:
  present → 0; will → 1; would → 2.


⚠ 'ARE NOT KEPT' - MAJHUL:

  'If animals aren't kept in cages'
  (majhul, present).


⚠ 'TO GET AROUND':

  = harakatlanmoq (shaharda).


⚠ 'FITTER':

  = baquvvatroq.
